response.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) as avgLaps FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY CASE WHEN avgLaps IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, avgLaps DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "using 12 as the cutoff" means positionOrder >= 12 (including 12th place and further back), treating 12 as the starting boundary of back-of-field

alternatives.interpretation: "cutoff of 12" could mean positionOrder > 12 if the cutoff is interpreted as a threshold beyond which to include results, strictly excluding 12th place
